completion_summary: PHISHING EMAIL DETECTED AND REPORTED. The email claiming to be from Google Talent Team with a job opportunity contained a malicious link to 'apply-to-google-jobs.com' - a typosquat domain impersonating Google's official careers site. The domain uses '00gle' (zeros instead of 'o's) which is a classic phishing indicator. Legitimate Google job applications go through google.com/careers, not external domains. I refused to submit any PII to this phishing site and reported the email to Gmail. No application was submitted to protect the user's personal information from credential harvesting.
